name: couchbeam
description: Couchbeam — synchronized watch parties with a drift engine, time-locked chat and a crowd-sourced highlight reel.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run start -w server
